blocks.text: Machine learning, data science ka ek hissa (subfield) hai jo systems ko tajurbe (experience) se behtar hone deta hai, baghair is ke ke har kaam ke liye alag se program likha jaye. Is mein data ke patterns parakh kar predictions (andaze) ya faisle kiye jate hain. Models ko train karne (sikhane) ke liye bare datasets istemal hote hain; jab naya data aata hai to model waqt ke saath dhalte aur behtar hote jate hain. Yeh technique aaj ki bohat si applications mein istemal hoti hai aur automation (khud-kaar kaam) aur intelligent (zaheen) systems ko chalati hai.

Pehle se tay rules (qawaid) ki bajaye machine learning system ko examples (misalon) se seekhne deti hai; system patterns pehchanta hai aur un se andaze lagata hai. Jitna zyada data system process karta hai, utna zyada accurate aur efficient hota jata hai. Is se smart applications chalti hain aur haath ka kaam kam hota hai.

blocks.title: Machine learning kahan aati hai
blocks.text: Yahan kitab machine learning ko data science ka hissa kehti hai, aur chapter ki Summary ise artificial intelligence ki shaakh (branch) kehti hai. Dono baatein aam taur par kahi jati hain: machine learning artificial intelligence ka hissa hai, aur data science ke bunyadi tools mein se bhi ek hai.
